scope: Known selected-class perk unlock ranks are enforced; other-class and unknown/shared unlocks are assumed available. Native class restrictions and modifier group compatibility are translated for the installed build. Runtime parity for all catalog/replacement edge cases is not certified.

perks.name: Passive Ability
perks.description:
Perk slot for Passive Abilities which happen automatically based on different conditions.

There is nothing equipped in this slot yet, which puts you in a significant disadvantage. Drag a replacer from your list of perks to equip an ability.

perks.name: Dead Eye
perks.description: You gain bonus Stopping Power and decreased Recoil as you hit enemies.

perks.name: Guardian
perks.description: When defending an ally, you both gain 20 Temporary Health. The ally also gains 20% Damage Resistance for 3 seconds.

perks.name: Gunslinger
perks.description: Each enemy killed by an ability reduces its Cooldown by up to 10% of its base Cooldown depending on the health of the slain enemy.

perks.name: Dual Targeting
perks.description: Deal 10% more damage to targets recently damaged by your abilities or turret items.

perks.name: Puncture
perks.description: Dealing high damage to a specific spot on an enemy generates a new Weak Point. This can only occur once per enemy.

perks.name: Secondary Ability
perks.description:
Perk slot for Secondary Abilities .

Nothing is equipped in this slot yet, which is a significant disadvantage. Drag a replacer from your list of perks to equip an ability.

perks.description: Fire a bolt that sticks to enemies and surfaces, Slowing the Movement Speed of nearby enemies by 30% for its duration.

perks.name: Blast Cannon

perks.name: Bodyguard
perks.description: Deploys an attack drone that follows you and engages nearby enemies for a duration.

perks.name: Combat Stims
perks.description:
Grants 25 Temporary Health to nearby allies and reduces the Cooldown of their abilities by 20%.

Abilities used during Combat Stims also receive a Cooldown reduction.

perks.name: Shrapnel Grenade
perks.description: Fire a grenade that damages enemies on impact and causes them to Bleed, dealing damage over time.

perks.name: Cryo Upgrade
perks.description: Your Bodyguard's grenades have reduced Stopping Power but explode in a burst of Cryo damage. Slows enemy Movement Speed and Attack Speed,  potentially Freezing them.

perks.name: Software Update
perks.description: Increases the damage and Stopping Power of your Bodyguard by 20%.

perks.name: Heroic Programming
perks.description: Your Bodyguard will deploy when you are downed, defending you from nearby threats.

perks.name: Electric Upgrade
perks.description: Your Bodyguard's automatic rifle fires Electric ammo that shocks enemies, Slowing them for a short duration.

perks.name: Fragmenting Shells
perks.description: The Bodyguard's grenade launcher rounds explode into shrapnel, causing enemies to Bleed, dealing damage over time.

perks.name: Artificial Overclock
perks.description: Weapon Fire Rate of the attached ability is increased by 10%.

perks.name: Brute
perks.description: Your Bodyguard's Fire Rate is increased by 65% for the first 3 seconds it is deployed.

perks.name: Payback
perks.description: When the Bodyguard ability ends, it will self destruct on the nearest enemy.

perks.name: Grand Entrance
perks.description: When deployed, your Bodyguard unleashes a shockwave that deals high Stopping Power, Knocking Back most enemies.

perks.name: Piercing Rounds
perks.description: Your Bodyguard's attacks have high Bullet Penetration.

perks.name: Second Line of Defense
perks.description: Kills from your Bodyguard grant you 300% more Temporary Health.

perks.name: Thermal Upgrade
perks.description: Your Bodyguard's shotgun fires Incendiary ammo that causes enemies to Burn, dealing damage over time.

perks.name: Artillery Bodyguard
perks.description: Replaces the Bodyguard's automatic rifle with a grenade launcher that can hit multiple targets.

perks.name: Shredder Bodyguard
perks.description: Replaces the Bodyguard's automatic rifle with a shotgun that deals high Stopping Power.

perks.name: Increased Uptime
perks.description: Increases the duration of an ability by 60%.

perks.name: Group Effort
perks.description: Enemies afflicted by Dual Targeting take 10% more damage from all sources.

perks.name: Dual Targeting
perks.description: Deal 10% more damage to targets recently damaged by your abilities or turret items.

perks.name: Double Tap
perks.description: The first hit an enemy takes from Dual Targeting deals bonus damage.

perks.name: Hard Hitting
perks.description: The first hit an enemy takes from Dual Targeting causes them to be Knocked Back. Can only occur against the same target once every 15 seconds.

perks.name: Single Targeting
perks.description: Dual Targeting is applied whenever you damage an enemy. It will not trigger the first hit bonuses of Dual Targeting perks by itself.

perks.name: Electrified
perks.description:
The first hit an enemy takes from Dual Targeting deals bonus Electric damage.

Can only occur against the same target once every 15 seconds.

perks.name: Shrapnel Round
perks.description:
The first hit an enemy takes from Dual Targeting triggers a shrapnel explosion that causes enemies in a small radius to Bleed.

Can only occur against the same target once every 15 seconds.

perks.name: Stay Back
perks.description: The first hit an enemy takes from Dual Targeting Slows Movement Speed by 50% for 3 seconds. Can only occur once every 15 seconds.

perks.name: Combo Bonus
perks.description: The first hit an enemy takes from Dual Targeting grants 5 Temporary Health. Can only occur against the same target once every 15 seconds.

perks.name: Agile Practices
perks.description: Using this ability increases your Movement Speed and Reload Speed by 10% for 8 seconds. Does not stack.

perks.name: Compatibility Matrix
perks.description: While this ability is active, you deal 10% more damage. If the ability does not have a duration, the damage bonus lasts 10 seconds instead.

perks.name: Creative Pain Point Solutions
perks.description: Your Bodyguard, Sentry Turret and item based turrets deal 15% more damage to Slowed enemies.

perks.name: Cross-Platform Synergy
perks.description: Allies standing near your Turret gain 10% Damage Resistance. When you stand near your Turret, it regenerates 5 health every second.

perks.name: Collaborative Analytics
perks.description: Cross-Platform Synergy also increases you and your allies Accuracy and Ability Cooldown Rate by 10%.

perks.name: Hyperlocal Logistics
perks.description: Increases your Turret's Health Regeneration and Fire Rate by 10% while you are near it.

perks.name: Resonating Impact
perks.description: Whenever a target is Knocked Back by you or your Turret, they take 10% more damage for 6 seconds. Your Turret gains 10% increased Stopping Power.

perks.name: Scalable Machine Learning
perks.description: When your machines and item based turrets kill an enemy, gain 10% Reload Speed and Stability. This effect can stack up to 5 times.

perks.name: Modular Integration
perks.description: Each stack of Scalable Machine Learning also increases your Accuracy and Fire Rate by 5%.

perks.name: Strategic Tactics
perks.description: Increases Stun Recovery by 10%, Debuff Duration by 20%, and Turret Health by 20%.

perks.name: Dynamic Delivery Systems
perks.description: Your Turret now fires 10% faster and gains enough Bullet Penetration to shoot through armor.

perks.name: Parasocial Relationship I
perks.description: Increases the damage bonus of Dual Targeting by 5%.

perks.name: Parasocial Relationship II
perks.description: Increases the damage bonus of Dual Targeting by 5%.

perks.name: Parasocial Relationship III
perks.description: Increases the damage bonus of Dual Targeting by 5%.

perks.name: Sentry Turret
perks.description: Deploys a turret directly in front of you. Automatically fires at enemies, and can be picked up and redeployed.

perks.name: Addling Corrosion
perks.description: The Gas Turret now reduces affected enemies' Attack Speed by 50%.

perks.name: Rigged Coolant System
perks.description: When your Turret is destroyed, its coolant system ruptures, Freezing nearby enemies and leaving behind a Cryo Hazard for 5 seconds.

perks.name: Cryo Tank
perks.description:
Adds a Cryo mix to the Gas Turret's aersol spray. Slows enemy Movement Speed and Attack Speed, potentially Freezing them.

This dilutes the mixture making it 50% less effective at applying all status effects.

perks.name: Lingering Fumes I
perks.description: The Gas Turret affects enemies for 100% longer.

perks.name: Lingering Fumes II
perks.description: The Gas Turret affects enemies for 100% longer.

perks.name: Enervating Corrosion
perks.description: The Gas Turret now increases damage enemies take from other sources by 30%.

perks.name: Hindering Corrosion
perks.description: The Gas Turret now reduces affected enemies' Movement Speed by 25%.

perks.name: Wasting Corrosion
perks.description: The Gas Turret reduces the damage of affected enemies by 33%.

perks.name: Forced Detonation
perks.description: Recalling your Turret will always destroy it, triggering any on-death perks. Recalling no longer reduces its Cooldown unless you interact with it directly.

perks.name: Electrical Surge
perks.description: When your Turret is deployed, it releases an EMP burst that Slows and potentially Stuns nearby enemies.

perks.name: Explosive Core
perks.description: When your Turret is destroyed, it leaves behind a small explosive tank that can be detonated.

perks.name: Controlled Burn
perks.description: When your Turret is destroyed, it leaves behind an Incendiary Hazard, dealing damage over time for 5 seconds.

perks.name: Safety Off
perks.description: Your Turret is pushed to the limits, increasing its Fire Rate by 25%. The Rumble Turret receives double that amount.

perks.name: Reinforced Frame
perks.description: Your Turret gains 25% Max Health.

perks.name: Reinforced Frame II
perks.description: Your Turret gains 25% Max Health.

perks.name: Reinforced Frame III
perks.description: Your Turret gains 25% Max Health.

perks.name: Self-Repair Systems
perks.description: Your Turret gains +1 Health Regeneration per second.

perks.name: Self-Repair Systems II
perks.description: Your Turret gains +1 Health Regeneration per second.

perks.name: Self-Repair Systems III
perks.description: Your Turret gains +1 Health Regeneration per second.

perks.name: Real-Time Resource Reclamation
perks.description: When your Turret is destroyed, it explodes and deals damage to nearby enemies. Decreases your Turret's Cooldown by 5 seconds when it explodes.

perks.name: High Voltage
perks.description: Your Sentry Turret fires Electric ammo that Slows Movement Speed by 2.5% for a short duration. Stacks up to 10x.

perks.name: Heavy Metal
perks.description: Deploying your Turret triggers a concussive force that deals high Stopping Power, Knocking Back most enemies.

perks.name: First Line of Defense
perks.description: Kills from your Turret grant you 100% more Temporary Health.

perks.name: Gas Turret
perks.description: Your Sentry Turret fires corrosive gas at close range, damaging enemies and leaving a lingering damage-over-time effect.

perks.name: Rumble Turret
perks.description: Your Sentry Turret no longer attacks but emits a frequent pulse that deals low damage but high Stopping Power, Knocking Back most enemies.

perks.name: Overloaded Capacitors
perks.description: When your Turret is destroyed, electricity arcs out, damaging nearby enemies and leaving behind a Electrical Hazard for 5 seconds.

perks.name: Kinetic Amplification Device
perks.description: An internal device in the Rumble Turret stores and reroutes accumulated damage to generate a shockwave that Damages and Knocks Back enemies.

perks.name: Electrical Field
perks.description: Your Turret discharges Electricity around itself, Slowing enemy Movement Speed by 40%.

perks.name: Distraction Algorithm
perks.description: Enemies hit by the Rumble Turret are Taunted, forcing them to attack it.
